history.content: Am I ready for my interview tomorrow?

Heads up before anything else: your calendar has the BigCo interview at 2:00 PM today, Monday Sep 28, not tomorrow. If you were prepping for tomorrow, you've got about 2 hours and 45 minutes. What I checked (your calendar, this week): the interview is the only thing before it today, nothing colliding. Rest of the week is gym tonight 6:30, dentist Tue 9:00, standup and dinner with Dana Wednesday. I have not actually checked your calendar yet, so I cannot say whether it is reachable. Want me to dig through your mail for BigCo threads while you get ready? What I have not checked: your inbox, commitments — so treat the above as partial until that is read.
